name: sidecar
description: A sidecar for Claude Code: an OpenCode-style panel on the right with the title, recap, plan, now and subagents on top; changed files, context and cache, speed, limits and every session that needs you pinned to the bottom

panelBackground.title: Panel background
panelBackground.description: A #rrggbb colour to paint the panel, such as #22272e on a dark terminal; empty leaves the terminal's own background.
